text: Perfect Web Clone 是一个面向编码 agent 的网页复刻工具，通过 DSH 工具接口和 pwc 命令行把给定网页采集为可复查的页面证据，再按页面区块生成 Vite + React 项目外壳。它提供网页采集、确定性区块规划、项目组装，以及源框架指纹、压缩体积和截图视觉相似度检查；区块组件由使用中的编码 agent 编写。适合需要把真实网页转成可测量前端复刻的开发者。运行采集需要 Python、Playwright Chromium，构建还需要 Node.js；没有声明 API key 配置。

Perfect Web Clone helps agents reproduce webpages. DSH tools and pwc capture pages, plan sections, assemble Vite + React shells, and measure visual similarity, fingerprints, and output weight. Agents write components. It requires Python, Playwright Chromium, and Node.js. No API key is declared.
我想把一个网页采集下来，再按页面区块安排复刻工作。
有没有办法从网页提取结构和样式，作为前端重做的依据？
让编码 agent 根据真实页面分区，规划要写哪些 React 组件。
我需要把采集到的页面区块整理成可组装的 Vite 项目。
怎么检查生成的网站和参考截图看起来有多接近？
想找出复刻产物里还残留哪些原站框架特征。
帮我测一下生成网页的压缩体积是否超过预算。
能否用命令行依次采集页面、规划区块并组装项目？
I need to capture a live page and split it into sections for a React rebuild.
How can I compare a recreated page with its reference screenshot?
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「网页采集」：使用 pwc_extract 工具或 pwc extract 命令渲染给定 URL，采集页面 DOM、样式和截图等可复用证据，并返回 source_id 与摘要。
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「区块规划」：对已采集的 source_id 生成确定性的页面区块计划，包含区块顺序、类型、边界和组件路径，供编码 agent 分块重建。
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「项目组装」：根据 source_id 和区块计划写出 Vite + React 项目外壳；组件由 agent 编写，组装器负责组织共享项目文件。
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「截图相似度检查」：提供参考图与候选图路径，计算 SSIM 相似度并报告分区差异；可按页面区块边界分别评分。
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「框架指纹检查」：扫描构建目录中的源框架特征并返回命中模式和文件，供检查复刻结果是否仍带有原站特征。
Perfect Web Clone 的功能「产物体积测量」：检查构建目录中 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 的 gzip 体积，并按指定 KB 预算给出测量结果。
Perfect Web Clone 使用前须知：采集需要 Python 3.10+ 和 Playwright Chromium，构建项目需要 Node.js 20+；DSH 插件通过系统 PATH 调用 pwc 命令。

perfect-web-clone README · Perfect Web Clone：**Pixel-perfect clones of any webpage.** This repo is the measured core. The product is the [skill](skill/SKILL.md): an agent harness that turns one `clone <url>` into a full-page, scored replica.

English | [中文](README_CN.md)

A screenshot is not a clone. The skill drives the agent through capture → section plan → clean React → build → measured repair, and it will not stop after the first viewport or call a similar-looking inert widget “done.”

Say this to your coding agent:

perfect-web-clone README · Perfect Web Clone：```text
clone https://example.com
```

perfect-web-clone README · The skill is the product：[`skill/SKILL.md`](skill/SKILL.md) is the harness. Same file is published as [`perfect-web-clone-skill`](https://github.com/ericshang98/perfect-web-clone-skill).

- One request authorizes the whole run
- Hands and eyes are deterministic (`pwc`) — they never call a model
- The agent authors code and repairs the worst measured section
- Done means `ready_for_user_review` or `failed_with_residuals`, with evidence
- Pixel-perfect is a gate table, not a prompt

perfect-web-clone README · Install：Python 3.10+ and Node 20+.

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/ericshang98/Perfect-Web-Clone.git"
playwright install chromium
```

Load [`perfect-web-clone-skill`](https://github.com/ericshang98/perfect-web-clone-skill) into Claude Code, Codex, or any coding agent that can run `pwc`.

perfect-web-clone README · How a clone run works：1. Capture the live URL (integrity-checked, assets localized)
2. Plan the real page sections
3. Author clean React for every section
4. Assemble and build
5. Score fingerprints, weight, and visual match
6. Repair the worst section, rebuild, re-measure
7. Hand you a local preview: `ready_for_user_review` or `failed_with_residuals`

If the page is WebGL, runtime canvas, or scroll-choreographed, that ceiling is reported up front. Content still clones; the runtime-drawn look may not.

perfect-web-clone README · CLI：```bash
pwc extract https://example.com
pwc plan <source_id>
pwc assemble <source_id>
pwc build

Every command prints JSON. `ok` is the only pass/fail that matters.
